svg.title: Format Comparison
svg.desc: Format Comparison: check matrix, 5 rows by 3 columns. SVG vs Markdown vs HTML. Enhanced Framer/Vercel precision glassmorphism.

hw:reasoning.hw:intent: Elevate the aesthetic hierarchy to top-tier developer-platform standard (Vercel/Framer/Linear) using structured specular glassmorphism, hairline rim-lighting, sub-pixel grid calibration, and high-clarity status glyph pills rather than bare glyphs.
hw:reasoning.hw:approach: Engineered a multi-tier layered chassis: 1) Ambient dark backdrop with a sharp 0.5px coordinate dot grid, 2) Multi-stop specular linear gradient card backing with an inner rim stroke, 3) Column hero glow utilizing directional illumination, 4) Translucent frosted badge capsules housing the check/cross status primitives, 5) Pure CSS-only transform/opacity scanline and reduced-motion fallbacks compliant with CIM doctrine.
hw:reasoning.hw:tradeoffs: Rejected blurry soft-gradient diffuse blobs in favor of crisp 0.5px–1px structural bevels, crisp coordinate dots, and exact opacity boundaries to maintain pure SVG vector sharpness across all display densities.
hw:reasoning.hw:spatial-notes: 600x436 (1.37 aspect ratio), 14px outer radius, 8px inner pill radius
